Rest.Title: Rest
Rest.BlockingNote: Hungry, Thirsty, Sleepy, and Cold block recovery of their linked attributes during this rest.
Rest.LongDescription: Restores 1 point in each damaged attribute that is not blocked by conditions.
Rest.HeatSource: There is a heat source. Clear Cold at the end of the rest.
Rest.LongConditionRemoval: Sleepy is cleared by sleep. Cold is cleared only with a heat source. These conditions still block recovery during this Long Rest.
Rest.ShortDescription: Characters can perform extended actions. Once per Quarter Day, one attribute may recover 1 point if an appropriate consumable or condition is used.

Rest.ShortAvailable: Short Rest recovery is available this Quarter Day.
Rest.ResetShortQuarter: Reset the Short Rest limit for a new Quarter Day
Rest.ShortManualConsumableNote: The module does not spend consumables automatically: food, water, smoking supplies, conversations, drugs, and potions can be represented in different ways. It records the recovery and writes the selected justification to the result.

Rest.ShortNoDamageError: The selected attribute does not need recovery.
Rest.NoChanges: Rest completed with no character-sheet changes.
Rest.ResetNotAllowed: Only the GM can reset the Short Rest limit.

Rest.StateProgressionCalendaria: Daily state progression is handled by Calendaria when a new day is registered. Long Rest does not advance daily states in this mode.

Heat.Plus: Endurance failure: increase Heat and apply consequences
Heat.Exposure: Apply final Endurance failure: +1 Heat and new-level consequences
Heat.Rest: Rest in shade with water: -1 Heat
Heat.Check: Post the rules reminder; roll Endurance manually
Heat.IncreaseText: Each final Endurance failure increases Heat by 1. The GM sets the frequency based on conditions; checks are not tied to quarter days.
Heat.DecreaseText: Cooling in shade with water removes 1 point. Lowering Heat causes no damage and does not heal lost attributes; stronger cooling can be recorded with −.

Level0.Label: Normal
Level0.Summary: No mechanical effect. Heat rises only after Endurance failure.

Level2.Label: Overheating
Level2.Summary: Overheating. No Endurance or Move penalties.

Level3.Label: Heat exhaustion
Level3.Summary: Reaching this level deals 1 Strength damage.
Level3.Consequence: Next failure: 3 → 4 and 1 damage each to Strength and Wits.

Level4.Label: Heat stroke
Level4.Summary: −1 to Endurance and Move is applied automatically.
Level4.Consequence: Next failure: Heat remains 4/4 and deals 1 damage each to Strength, Wits and Agility. Cooling below 4 removes the penalties.

Heat.PendingChange: Finish the pending Heat change before changing its level again.
Heat.WorkflowHint: After a final Endurance failure, press +. At 4/4 another failure deals damage. The − button reduces Heat without damage. To correct the level manually, type it in the counter.

Addiction.Pending: Awaiting manual Endurance. Apply abilities and record the final outcome below. The cycle and penalties are unchanged until then.
Addiction.Ready: Start the morning: craving 1–2 or withdrawal requires manual Endurance.
Addiction.DoseQuestion: Is a dose available to take? Taking it resets the cycle to decline d12. On failure without a dose the cycle still advances. Items are not spent automatically.

Outcome.controlled: Morning resolved: craving controlled, cycle advanced.
Outcome.failure-dose: Endurance failed; dose taken, cycle reset to decline d12.
Outcome.failure-no-dose: Endurance failed; no dose available, cycle advanced.
Outcome.dose: Dose taken: cycle reset to decline d12.

Addiction.TakeDoseQuestion: Confirm that an available dose is taken. This resets the cycle to decline d12. No dose or Cancel leaves the state unchanged. Items are not spent automatically.
Addiction.EditState: Edit Addiction phase, die and days

Addiction.Intro: {actor} wakes and feels the call of {condition}...
Addiction.EnduranceRequired: Roll Endurance manually, apply abilities and record Success or Failure in STAT. On failure, confirm dose availability: taking a dose resets d12; without one the cycle advances.
Addiction.Controlled: The craving is controlled. No Endurance roll is required today. Remember to advance the cycle.
Addiction.Relapse:
{actor} gives in to {condition} and takes a dose.
The addiction cycle returns to its beginning (decline: d12).
Addiction.ControlledAutomatic: The craving is controlled. No Endurance roll is required today; the addiction cycle advances automatically.
Addiction.ControlledCured: The craving is controlled. The addiction cycle advances automatically and the condition is cured.

Heat.Check0: The GM calls for Endurance. Record the final failure with Endurance: failure; success leaves the counter unchanged.
Heat.Check1: The GM calls for Endurance. Record the final failure with Endurance: failure; success leaves the counter unchanged.
Heat.Check2: Roll Endurance manually. Failure raises Heat to 3 and deals 1 Strength damage.
Heat.Check3: Roll Endurance manually. Failure raises Heat to 4 and deals 1 damage each to Strength and Wits.
Heat.Check4: Apply −1 to Endurance. Failure leaves Heat at 4/4 and deals 1 damage each to Strength, Wits and Agility.

Mor.BecamePermanent: Rolled 1. The point becomes permanent. Mor: {current}/{permanent}.
